rationale: Record a runtime performance change that crosses these families through their tools/import-design/** and .agents/skills/import-design/** selectors. The materialized React runtime entry (tools/import-design/jsx-runtime/materialized_runtime_entry.mjs) and @pulp/react host config memoize each binding's path and each node's filtered children per metadata pass, set a label's typography once per face, treat a data-* attribute change that no selector names as paint-only, and let a paint-only commit restore only the colour channels the pass owns instead of re-running the scoped metadata pass; the runtime fingerprint and import-design/view-bridge skills describe the new revision. Captured metadata, DesignIR, capture path, importer lowering, renderer, codegen output, fixtures and thresholds are unchanged, and the new commit-cost tests assert the same final painted state as the full pass. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest about a change that crossed their selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
